subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Computer virus is terror to the users of computers. (a) ⎯⎯ it is not the biological virus, it disturbs the plain operation of a computer. Computer virus is usually a programme to delete the files which are saved (b) ⎯⎯ useful memories. Sometimes, the virus attacks the hard disk (c) ⎯⎯ harms it. (d) ⎯⎯ things happen (e) ⎯⎯, no operation is possible after the attack.
guide_solution: (a) Though/Although (b) as (c) and (d) When If (e) so
